description_en: Creates a configuration resource for a specified instance
description_zh: 为指定实例配置创建新的配置资源
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice create-instance-resource --instance-id pairec-cn-test1 --category DataManagement --group storage --type OSS --uri bucket-test-123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstanceResource

parameters.name: category

parameters.description_en:
The resource group.

If the resource category is DataManagement, valid values are:

- storage

- modelpipeline

- datastorage

- modeltrain

If the resource category is Engine, valid values are:

- feature

- predict

- recall

- recengine

If the resource category is Monitor, valid values are:

- logs

- logsback

- coldstart

- deploy
